title: SMOK Tech247 Replacement Pods 2ml - 2 Pack
description: Keep your vaping at peak performance with the Smok TECH247 Pods, specifically designed for the Smok TECH247 Pod Kit. Each pod in this convenient 2-pack features a 2ml e-liquid capacity, allowing for extended vaping sessions with fewer refills. The pods are engineered for ease of use, featuring a simple top-fill system that makes e-liquid top-ups quick and mess-free. Crafted with precision, these pods are compatible with the Smok M Series Coils, whose mesh construction ensures even heating and exceptional flavour extraction. Whether you prefer a Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) or a Direct-To-Lung (DTL) experience, these pods with your chosen coil cater to every preference, delivering a smooth, flavourful, and satisfying vape each time. The Smok TECH247 Pods are an essential choice for those who value convenience and quality. Their easy-to-use design and compatibility with high-performance M coils make them a must-have for TECH247 kit users.
